name: building-blocks-callouts
title: Callouts
description: Icon-led tinted callout boxes for notes, tips, and warnings inside documentation and long-form content.
useWhen: Icon-led tinted callout boxes for notes, tips, and warnings inside documentation and long-form content.
avoidWhen: Avoid callouts when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Callouts uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
